# Support

Use the narrowest public channel that fits the question so answers remain searchable
and maintainers can respond in one place.

## Product and setup questions

Start with the [documentation site](https://docs.derive.to). If the documentation does not
answer the question, open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/derive-to/derive/discussions)
with the environment, what you are trying to achieve, and what you have already tried.

## Confirmed bugs and feature requests

Use the repository's structured [issue forms](https://github.com/derive-to/derive/issues/new/choose).
Search existing issues first. Include a minimal reproduction for a bug and explain the
underlying workflow or outcome for a feature request.

## Security and abuse

Do not report exploitable vulnerabilities in a public issue or discussion. Follow
[the security policy](../SECURITY.md) and email `security@derive.to`. Report phishing, malware,
impersonation, or other abusive hosted content to `abuse@derive.to` with the full URL.

## Hosted account and billing help

Email `hello@derive.to` for private account, workspace, billing, or procurement matters.
Do not post personal data, credentials, private artifact URLs, or billing information in
GitHub.

Community support is best effort. Security reports and paid support commitments follow
their separately stated response policies.
